# ngc/Sass trap — RULE 2 allowlist
#
# Files listed here may keep a `.scss` extension while being referenced from a
# component's styleUrls in an ngc-only package (no Sass compilation step).
#
# This waives the EXTENSION rule ONLY. RULE 1 (Sass-only constructs: `&__`/`&--`
# concatenation, `//` comments, `@use`/`@mixin`/`$vars`/`#{}`) is NEVER waived —
# those constructs are dead in production regardless of what this file says.
#
# Add an entry only when the file is verifiably Sass-free AND has a reason to
# keep the extension. Document the reason.
#
# Gate: .github/scripts/check-ngc-scss.sh   (see MemberJunction/MJ#3105)

# --- @memberjunction/ng-ui-components -------------------------------------
# page-header.scss is ALSO shipped as a standalone global asset (see the
# package's `copy-assets` script, which cpy's it into dist/lib/page-header).
# Consumers may reference it by path, so the extension is part of its public
# surface. Verified Sass-free: plain CSS + native nesting only.
packages/Angular/Generic/ui-components/src/lib/page-header/page-header.scss

# --- @memberjunction/ng-archive-manager -----------------------------------
# Verified Sass-free (plain CSS + native `&:hover`-style nesting, which the
# browser handles natively). Kept as-is to avoid churn; new files in this
# package must be `.css`.
packages/Angular/Generic/archive-manager/src/lib/archive-config/archive-config-admin.component.scss
packages/Angular/Generic/archive-manager/src/lib/archive-run-viewer/archive-run-viewer.component.scss
packages/Angular/Generic/archive-manager/src/lib/archive-restore/archive-restore-dialog.component.scss
packages/Angular/Generic/archive-manager/src/lib/archive-status/archive-status-badge.component.scss
